blocks.text: Elements may be categorized according to element families. An element family is a set of elements sharing common properties. There are five famous families of elements in the periodic table:

items: Alkali metals (Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs, Fr)
Alkaline earth metals (Be, Mg, Ca, Ba, R.)
Transition metals (Sc, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn)
Halogens (F, Cl, Br, I, At, Ts)
Noble gases (He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe, Rn, Og)
